data.description:
Write failing tests for the post-commit hook that consumes (deletes) the override token.

## Test file
tests/hooks/test-post-commit-override-cleanup.sh (CREATE)

## Test cases (all must FAIL until T5 is implemented)
1. test_cleanup_removes_token — given override.token exists at $ARTIFACTS_DIR/override.token, cleanup removes it and exits 0
2. test_cleanup_idempotent — given no token file, cleanup still exits 0 (rm -f is safe; no error on absent file)
3. test_single_use_cycle — writes a token to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/override.token, runs cleanup, asserts token file no longer exists — confirming single-use property (token consumed; re-authorization requires re-running dso commit-override)

## Classification
RED — all tests must fail before implementation

## TDD requirement
Commit these tests using the .test-index RED marker protocol.

## Dependency note
Depends on T2 to ensure .test-index writes are serialized.

## Files to modify
- tests/hooks/test-post-commit-override-cleanup.sh (CREATE)
